# meshy.ai

> Meshy is an AI-powered 3D content generation platform that transforms text prompts and images into production-ready 3D models in minutes. Trusted by 15M+ creators worldwide including game developers, 3D artists, VFX studios, and product designers. Features include Text-to-3D, Image-to-3D, AI Texturing, AI Animation with 600+ motion presets, and a developer API. Meshy 7 is our latest foundation model, available for Image-to-3D in the Meshy app and for both text and image input over the API, tuned for geometry alignment between the input and the generated 3D model. Image-to-3D generation offers three resolution tiers: Standard, Ultra 2K, and Ultra 4K. Ultra 4K generates geometry at 4096³ — a first for any 3D generative model — for intricate assets with fine detail. Ultra 2K and Ultra 4K require a paid plan and take longer to generate. Export to all major formats (FBX, OBJ, GLB, USDZ, STL, BLEND, 3MF, DXF). Enterprise-ready with ISO 27001 and SOC2 certification.

## Core Features

- [Text to 3D AI Generator](https://www.meshy.ai/features/text-to-3d): Generate production-ready 3D models from text descriptions using Meshy's AI. Create characters, props, vehicles, and environments with PBR textures. Supports Smart Topology mode for game-ready assets and high-detail sculpting for cinematic quality.
- [Image to 3D AI Converter](https://www.meshy.ai/features/image-to-3d): Transform 2D images, concept art, and photos into detailed 3D models. Upload single or multiple reference images for multi-view consistency. Ideal for turning sketches, product photos, and artwork into 3D assets.
- [AI Texture Generator](https://www.meshy.ai/features/ai-texture-generator): Apply AI-generated PBR textures to any 3D model. Create realistic materials, stylized looks, or match specific art styles. Includes texture healing and smart repair tools for fixing imperfections.
- [AI Animation Generator](https://www.meshy.ai/features/ai-animation-generator): Automatically rig and animate 3D characters with 600+ motion presets. One-click auto-rigging for bipeds and quadrupeds. Export animations to Unity, Unreal, Blender, and other game engines.
- [Meshy 3D Agent](https://www.meshy.ai/features/3d-agent): Conversational AI agent for 3D creation — describe what you want and the Agent brainstorms, generates, refines, and exports in one chat. Now available on the Free plan, running on a more capable foundation model, with 21 official templates to start from in Discover.
- [All Features Overview](https://www.meshy.ai/features): Complete overview of Meshy's AI-powered 3D generation capabilities including Text-to-3D, Image-to-3D, AI Texturing, Animation, and workflow tools for professional 3D content creation.

## 3D Tools

- [Free 3D File Converter](https://www.meshy.ai/3d-tools/file-converter): Convert between 3D file formats online for free. Supports FBX, OBJ, GLB, GLTF, STL, USDZ, BLEND, and more. Batch conversion available with texture preservation and mesh optimization.
- [Online 3D Model Viewer](https://www.meshy.ai/3d-tools/online-viewer): View and inspect 3D models directly in your browser. Supports all major formats including FBX, OBJ, GLB, and STL. Examine geometry, textures, and animations without installing software.
- [3D Model Splitter](https://www.meshy.ai/3d-tools/3d-model-splitter): Split a 3D model into printable parts online. Auto Split cuts along natural part boundaries and accepts a plain-language description of the parts you want separated (for example, "separate the wings from the body"), then caps every surface watertight, arranges the parts on the build plate, and exports a print-ready 3MF (imports STL, OBJ, or GLB).

## Use Cases

- [AI 3D Assets for Game Development](https://www.meshy.ai/use-cases/free-game-assets): Generate game-ready 3D assets for Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot. Create characters, props, environments, and weapons with PBR textures. Features Smart Topology mode, auto-rigging, 600+ animation presets, and LOD support.
- [3D Printing & STL Files](https://www.meshy.ai/3d-printing): Create print-ready 3D models with Meshy AI. Generate STL and 3MF files optimized for FDM and resin printers. Features multi-color printing support, mesh repair, and manifold geometry checks.
- [Product Design & Prototyping](https://www.meshy.ai/use-cases/product-design): Accelerate product development with AI-generated 3D prototypes. Create packaging, consumer products, and industrial designs. Export to CAD-compatible formats for manufacturing.
- [Film & VFX Production](https://www.meshy.ai/use-cases/film-production): Generate high-quality 3D assets for film and video production. Create detailed characters, props, and environments for visual effects. Export to industry-standard formats for compositing.
- [E-commerce 3D Visualization](https://www.meshy.ai/shopify): Create interactive 3D product models for online stores. Generate photorealistic renders and AR previews. Increase conversion rates with immersive product experiences.
- [3D Animation & Motion Graphics](https://www.meshy.ai/use-cases/3d-animation): Create animated 3D content with AI-powered rigging and motion presets. Generate character animations, product visualizations, and motion graphics. Export to video or real-time formats.
- [Toy & Collectible Design](https://www.meshy.ai/use-cases/toy-design): Design toys, action figures, and collectibles with AI assistance. Generate print-ready models for prototyping and production. Features articulation support and multi-part assembly.
- [Interior Design Visualization](https://www.meshy.ai/use-cases/interior-design): Create 3D furniture, decor, and architectural elements for interior design projects. Generate photorealistic renders and AR room previews. Export to common design software formats.
- [VFX & Post-Production](https://www.meshy.ai/use-cases/vfx): Accelerate visual effects workflows with AI-generated 3D assets. Create CG elements, environment props, and character models. Seamless integration with Blender, Maya, and Houdini.
- [Free 3D Models Library](https://www.meshy.ai/free-3d-models): Access and create free 3D models with Meshy AI. Browse community-generated assets or generate your own. Download in multiple formats for any creative project.

## Developer API & Documentation

- [Meshy API Overview](https://www.meshy.ai/api): Integrate AI-powered 3D generation into your applications with the Meshy API. RESTful endpoints for Text-to-3D, Image-to-3D, texturing, and animation. SDKs available for Python, JavaScript, and Unity.
- [API Documentation](https://docs.meshy.ai/en): Complete API reference documentation with code examples, authentication guides, and endpoint specifications. Learn how to generate 3D models programmatically with detailed tutorials.
- [Text-to-3D API](https://docs.meshy.ai/#text-to-3d-beta): Generate 3D models from text descriptions via API. Supports style parameters, topology options, and quality settings. Returns downloadable 3D files in multiple formats.
- [Image-to-3D API](https://docs.meshy.ai/#image-to-3d): Convert images to 3D models programmatically. Upload single or multiple reference images. Supports PNG, JPG, and WebP input formats.
- [Multi-Image-to-3D API](https://docs.meshy.ai/#multi-image-to-3d-beta): Generate 3D models from multiple reference images for improved accuracy. Upload front, side, and back views for better geometry reconstruction.
- [Remesh API](https://docs.meshy.ai/#remesh-beta): Optimize and retopologize 3D meshes via API. Reduce polygon count while preserving detail. Prepare models for real-time applications.
- [Rigging & Animation API](https://docs.meshy.ai/#rigging-animation-beta): Auto-rig characters and apply animations programmatically. Choose from 600+ motion presets. Export rigged and animated models in FBX format.
- [Retexture API](https://docs.meshy.ai/#ai-texturing-beta): Apply AI-generated textures to existing 3D models via API. Supports text prompts and reference images for texture generation.
- [Text-to-Image API](https://docs.meshy.ai/#text-to-image-beta): Generate AI images optimized for 3D conversion. Create concept art, reference images, and multi-view renders for Image-to-3D workflows.
- [Image-to-Image API](https://docs.meshy.ai/#image-to-image-beta): Transform and enhance images for 3D generation. Style transfer, upscaling, and multi-view generation for improved 3D model quality.

## Plugins & Integrations

- [Meshy for Blender](https://docs.meshy.ai/en/blender-plugin/introduction): Official Blender plugin for AI 3D generation. Generate and import models directly in Blender. Features bridge mode for seamless workflow integration.
- [Meshy for Unity](https://docs.meshy.ai/en/unity-plugin/introduction): Unity plugin for AI-powered 3D asset creation. Generate game-ready models inside the Unity Editor. Includes auto-import, rigging, and animation support.
- [Meshy for Unreal Engine](https://docs.meshy.ai/en/unreal-plugin/bridge-to-unreal): Unreal Engine plugin for AI 3D model generation. Create assets directly in the Unreal Editor. Optimized for game development workflows.
- [Meshy for Godot](https://docs.meshy.ai/en/godot-plugin/bridge-to-godot): Godot engine plugin for AI 3D generation. Generate and import models in the Godot Editor. Compatible with Godot 4.x.
- [Meshy for Maya](https://docs.meshy.ai/en/maya-plugin/bridge-to-maya): Autodesk Maya plugin for AI 3D asset creation. Bridge workflow for seamless import of generated models into Maya scenes.
- [Meshy for 3ds Max](https://docs.meshy.ai/en/3ds-max-plugin/bridge-to-3ds-max): Autodesk 3ds Max plugin for AI 3D generation. Import AI-generated models directly into 3ds Max projects.
- [Meshy for Bambu Lab](https://docs.meshy.ai/en/webapp/3d-printing-platforms/bambu-studio): Direct integration with Bambu Lab 3D printers. Send AI-generated models to Bambu Studio for printing. Supports multi-color 3MF export.

## Blog - Product Announcements

- [Meshy N1: Cleanest and Fastest Texturing](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/meshy-n1-texture): Meshy's first native texturing model generates texture directly in 3D, with no projection seams. It scores 77% on the new Texture Cleanliness benchmark versus 47-59% for Hi3D, Tripo and Rodin, and is the fastest texturer tested at a 14 s median.
- [Meshy 7.1: Attention to the Closest Detail](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/meshy-7-1-launch): How Meshy generates the richest geometric detail of any image-to-3D model, and the Detail Richness benchmark behind it.
- [Meshy-6: Smarter Geometry, Faster Workflows](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/meshy-6-launch): Announcing Meshy-6 with cleaner geometry, sharper hard-surface details, Low Poly Mode, multi-color 3D printing, and upgraded APIs for production-ready 3D assets.
- [Meshy-4: Break Grounds](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/meshy-4-break-grounds): Meshy-4 release announcement with major improvements to 3D generation quality and new features.
- [Meshy-3 Turbo: Accelerating Creativity](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/meshy-3-turbo-accelerating-creativity): Meshy-3 Turbo launch with faster generation speeds and improved output quality.
- [Meshy 3: Sculptures, PBR, and Image to 3D](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/meshy3-sculptures-pbr-and-image-to-3d): Meshy 3 release introducing sculpture mode, enhanced PBR texturing, and improved Image-to-3D.
- [Meshy 2.5: Text to 3D, Reloaded!](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/meshy-2.5-text-to-3d-enhancements): Major update to Text-to-3D capabilities with enhanced quality and new style options.
- [Introducing Meshy-2](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/introducing-meshy-2): Meshy-2 launch announcement with next-generation AI 3D model generation.
- [Meshy-1: Generate 3D Models with AI in Just a Minute](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/meshy-1-generate-3d-models-with-ai-in-just-a-minute): Original Meshy launch introducing AI-powered 3D model generation from text prompts.
- [500+ Animation Presets Now Available](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/free-3d-animation): Massive animation update with 500+ motion presets for character animation.
- [Introducing New Meshy UI](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/new-meshy-workspace): Quick guide to Meshy's unified workspace with improved workflow and interface.
- [Meshy Education Plan Is Live](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/education-plan): Announcing discounted AI tools for students and educators with special education pricing.
- [Announcing the Meshy Fellowship 2025](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/fellowship-2025): Meet the recipients of the Meshy Fellowship program supporting emerging 3D creators.

## Blog - User Stories & Case Studies

- [From 7 Days to 2 Hours: Jupiter Enterprise Use Case](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/jupiter-enterprise-use-case): How Jupiter scaled glasses-free 3D content production with Meshy AI, reducing creation time by 98%.
- [How Thorns Tavern Cut Production Time by 90%](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/thorns-tavern-enterprise-use-case): TTRPG miniature company transforms workflow with Meshy AI, dramatically reducing 3D miniature production time.
- [From Procreate to Cinema 4D with Meshy](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/2d-concept-to-3d-sculpt): Artist Mikhail Arce-Ignacio bridges the 2D-to-3D gap using Meshy in his creative workflow.
- [kirinkarwai's 3D Art Journey with Meshy AI](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/3d-art-ai-inspiration): How kirinkarwai transforms literature into emotional 3D art using Meshy's AI tools.
- [EvilKris Creates Horror Game Assets with Meshy](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/3d-horror-game-assets-creation-for-famished): From flash games to horror worlds - how EvilKris uses Meshy to shape the game Famished.
- [Chad Hunter's 3D Printing Journey with Meshy](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-3d-printing-dioramas-tabletop): From playdough to pro-level dioramas - how Chad Hunter prints his imagination.
- [Omar's Cosmicrafts Space Game with Meshy](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-3d-space-game-asset): How AI revolutionizes 3D assets for infinite space games in Cosmicrafts.
- [Tansy Embraces Her Inner Artist with Meshy](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-generated-3d-art): From ideas to identity - how Meshy helped an artist find creative expression.
- [Annie Weaves AI and Cultural Heritage](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-ich-3d-art-meshy-tool): From heritage to digital - empowering intangible cultural heritage through 3D art.
- [FLOW STATE: AI Accelerates Indie Development](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-in-game-development): From concept to combat - how AI accelerated one indie developer's vision.
- [Backrooms Game Development with Meshy](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/backrooms-game): How CoolPuzzler builds a survival game with documentation using Meshy.
- [Zaf's Cinematic 3D Secrets](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/cinematic-3d): How Meshy cuts modeling time and boosts atmosphere for cinematic 3D work.
- [Indie Game Character Design with Soliloquis](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/indie-game-character-design-workflow): Breaking indie game character design bottlenecks with Meshy workflows.
- [Cristobal's Indie Game Development Journey](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/indie-game-development-process): From architecture to indie worlds - building Treasures of the Cajon with Meshy.
- [Remnants of R'lyeh Horror Game Development](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/indie-horror-game): Crafting a Lovecraftian horror game with AI-generated 3D assets.
- [Jlemarchand's Point-and-Click Adventure](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/point-and-click-game): From AA tools programmer to solo dev - building adventure games with Meshy.
- [Sivan's Second Life Avatar Creation](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/second-life-avatar-creation-with-meshy): How Meshy transformed creative workflow for virtual world avatar creation.
- [Shimmy's AI-Powered 3D Modeling Journey](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/unleashing-creative-potential-with-meshy-ai-powered-3d-modeling): Unleashing creative potential with Meshy's AI tools.
- [Marcos Medel Transforms VFX Workflow](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/vfx-workflow): From hours to minutes - how Meshy AI transforms VFX production.
- [Solo Indie Dev Axx's 3D Platformer](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/solo-indie-dev-3d-platformer): How Meshy AI turned a surreal 3D platformer dream into reality.
- [Arena Pong: Retro Classic Gets 3D Twist](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-tools-for-indie-game-development): Indie dev uses Meshy to add 3D elements to a retro pong game.

## Blog - Education & Learning

- [HUFA Integrates Meshy for 3D Art Education](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-3d-asset-creation-art-education): How HUFA transforms cross-disciplinary 3D art education with Meshy.
- [VITA School Teacher Transforms Game Design Class](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-3d-game-asset-creation-for-students): From technical barriers to creative explosion in 8th-grade game design.
- [Eric York Empowers Students with Meshy](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/ai-3d-modeling-robotics-game-design-stem-education): Robotics and game design education using AI 3D generation.
- [3D Printing for Inclusive Special Education](https://www.meshy.ai/blog/3d-printing-inclusive-special-education): How a Turkish vocational educator turns sketches and symbols into tactile teaching aids for inclusive learning.
